title: MIND: A Multi-agent Framework for Zero-shot Harmful Meme Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating the model's zero-shot classification accuracy and Macro-F1 score on the MAMI dataset, which predominantly contains misogynistic memes and content derogatory towards women.
Qualitative evaluation and error analysis of the framework's ability to detect hateful or stereotypical memes targeting religious groups (e.g., Islamophobia) using examples from the FHM dataset.
Qualitative evaluation through case studies demonstrating the framework's ability to detect and reason about discriminatory messaging targeted at the LGBTQ+ community.

Measuring the model's zero-shot classification performance on the HarM dataset, which contains harmful memes manipulating public credibility, exploiting political divides, and spreading COVID-19 misinformation.
